title: Prepare Parse-object ownership reset and connection unlink

scope.rationale: sqlite3ParseObjectReset releases every allocation owned by a native Parse object in source order, executes uncommon cleanup callbacks, restores the connection lookaside-disable count and size, and unlinks the Parse from the connection head.

external_source_responsibilities: Connection allocator, ExprList ownership, and ParseCleanup callback contracts
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete reset body is assigned. Source-shaped prepare entry dispatch remains open.

inputs: Connection-head, non-nested native Parse object initialized against a non-null connection
outputs: Released table locks, cleanup records, labels, and constant expressions; restored lookaside state; restored outer Parse head
contracts.ownership: Consumes all Parse-owned cleanup records and selected allocation fields; callback payload ownership is delegated to each cleanup callback.
contracts.state_and_results: Cleanup callbacks execute LIFO. Lookaside bDisable decreases by disableLookaside and sz is restored only when the resulting count is zero.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns connection serialization. Cleanup callbacks may release arbitrary parser-owned objects; no direct I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Reset has no result code and performs no allocation; the connection is left linked to pOuterParse.

representation_differences: Typed allocator and ownership helpers replace sqlite3DbNNFreeNN and sqlite3ExprListDelete macros without changing release order.
The active non-debug profile has no earlyCleanup field responsibility.

oracle.protocol: Seed a native Parse as the connection head with an outer Parse and lookaside-disable counts, reset it, and observe owner linkage and both remaining-disabled and fully-enabled lookaside states; allocation/callback branches remain compile-traced pending a pinned-C probe.
oracle.normalization: Pointer addresses are compared only by identity; source scalar state is exact.

assurance.oom: Reset allocates nothing; previously-owned allocations remain subject to their owner contracts.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No direct I/O; connection serialization remains external.
assurance.malformed_input: Non-head, nested, or database-less Parse inputs violate source assertions.
assurance.continuation: The outer Parse becomes the live connection parse owner after reset.
assurance.performance: Linear only in the uncommon cleanup stack; all other releases are constant-time.

integration.native_call_path: The owner is compile- and unit-traced; source-shaped prepare entry dispatch remains pending.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: The simplified schema_initialization ParseObject reset remains a distinct non-native planning owner.

independent_review.notes: Requires prepare integration, pinned-C cleanup trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

Add pinned-C cleanup-order and callback trace.
